still_deferred: ch-obs (PROBE-CLOSED 2026-07-29): remains unprocessed for a METHODOLOGICAL reason, not time. Pilot found (a) 20 files not 24, half of them single continuous 65-88 min session recordings; (b) no gaze overlay on raw feed; (c) DECISIVE: for BOR/INT the surround is a featureless black void, so global optical flow tracks stimulus visual richness rather than head motion -- no valid cross-stimulus restlessness measure is obtainable from this material without panel-tracking or within-stimulus normalization. Alignment-anchor value is real but unneeded: no section finding is a time-course claim.
